prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production browser favicon / app icon for The Nature Nest boutique hotel and resort. Near-flat vector-style precision with only very restrained satin gold shading; straight-on orthographic view. Uniform forest green background to every edge, no outer border, no frame, no circle, no rounded corner white margins, no mockup, no surrounding objects, no tiny decorative lines, no hotel wordmark, no extra letters, no tagline, no watermark. This is the actual standalone icon artwork, not a presentation of an icon.
notes: The generated artwork is unchanged; smaller PNGs are size exports and the ICO packages 16/32/48px PNG frames.
